description: Introduces the Avalon Exploration Fleet as a playable faction with Nexerelin support. Features heat-based weapons that cause enemy overheating and modular Sparrow shuttles and Falcon destroyers with swappable modules. Includes a questline featuring the scientist Krss'Brk.

discordPostHtml:
Yo this is a full translation of the Avali_Explorer by the CN author MAJOR_Kai with a bit amount of AI assistant.

  • The Avalon Exploration Fleet (AEF): a full Avali faction.
  • A list of Heat weapons that can heat enemy ships until they overheat.
  • Nexerelin: A Avali faction start.
  • modular Sparrow shuttles and Falcon destroyers you refit with swappable bow, engine and armor modules.
  • A questline with the scientist Krss'Brk.

Please hit me up if something goes wry or if the translation is a bit weird anywhere
